title: Reviews
description: Customer reviews section assembled from small review components: foundation header, aggregate proof, rating tile, platform links, review cards, slider controls, and a shared details modal.

normalization: Normalize platform keys to yandex, 2gis, google, otzovik, and flamp when possible.
Accept legacy logo-* platform aliases as input only; new code renders canonical reviews platform classes.
Use platform logo_type to choose icon color: white maps to icon-{platform}.svg, black maps to icon-{platform}-black.svg. Default is white for CMS compatibility; registry landing data uses black.
Use 140 visible characters as the canonical long-review threshold for rendering the read-more trigger.

runtime: shared modal system handling data-modal-id and data-modal-close
Swiper base styles and navigation module

sourceNaming.white: Exported and normalized to the icon-{platform}.svg convention.
sourceNaming.black: Exported from Grani and renamed with the -black suffix.

aliases.purpose: Legacy names from existing reviews implementations. Agents use these only to find and map old code; new code must use the canonical naming fields.

agent.usage: Use this block for customer reputation and reviews sections where the data contract includes section copy, aggregate rating proof, platform links, review cards, optional read-more actions, and a shared reviews modal. The canonical reviews example is composed from small classes instead of section-level layout modifiers.
transferSteps: Copy section-reviews.blade.php as the target section view unless the target project has an explicit naming map.
Map the target CMS to reviews section copy and getPlatformsWithReviews platform/review data before editing Blade structure.
Keep the header on foundation primitives: section-header, section-title, and section-text.
Compose proof from reviews-proof, reviews-rating, reviews-platforms, and reviews-platform instead of adding section-level reviews--* modifiers.
Copy platform logo assets to assets_url()/images/reviews and set platform logo_type to black on light surfaces or white on dark/accent surfaces.
Use reviews-slider as a horizontal Swiper rail with auto-width review cards and project slider-arrow controls.
Keep one modalReviews instance after the section. Every long review card must own its own data-reviews-modal-template.
Initialize initReviews(root) after injecting registry/demo HTML and in target projects after the reviews section is mounted.
acceptance: The block renders with .section.reviews and no reviews--* layout modifier on the section.
source.blade, source.scss, source.js, source.fixture, and source.demoHtml paths exist.
Section copy is read from reviewsText:reviewsText; platform ratings and review cards are read from getPlatformsWithReviews().

The header uses foundation section-header/section-title/section-text primitives; reviews compositions may use section-header--column, section-header--column-start, or section-header--split without block SCSS overriding those primitives.
The aggregate proof uses reviews-proof, reviews-rating, reviews-platforms, and reviews-platform classes.
The review carousel uses reviews-slider, reviews-slider__track, reviews-slider__controls, and reviews-slider__button classes.
Only long reviews render data-reviews-modal-open with the text "Читать полностью".
Each long review owns a data-reviews-modal-template template used by the shared modalReviews instance.
Closing by close button, backdrop, or Escape clears data-reviews-modal-content.
Block-specific SCSS does not override foundation primitives such as section, container, section-header, section-title, section-text, or button.
